p: to do: Showing that it is not enough to hear the word, unless we express it by the example of our lives.
prove thee: Which is declared in afflictions, either by patience, or by grudging against God's visitation.
bread only: Man does not live by meat only, but by the power of God, who gives it strength to nourish us.
swell: As those that go barefoot.
chasteneth thee: So that his affliction are signs of his fatherly love toward us.
whose stones are iron: Where there are mines of metal.
bless the LORD thy God for: To receive God's benefits and not be thankful, is to despise God in them.
be lifted up: By attributing God's benefits to your own wisdom and labour, or to good fortune.
giveth thee power to get wealth: If things concerning this life proceed only from God's mercy, how much more do spiritual gifts and everlasting life.
testify against you this day that: Or take to witness the heaven and the earth, as in De 4:26.
